queries.query: Optimize the latency of this existing ONNX model on QNN NPU using WinML. Target p50 below 15 ms without losing correctness.
Use WinML to reduce CPU inference latency of my supported ONNX model; investigate graph transformations and confirm the winner.
My ONNX model already runs on DirectML. Find and validate graph optimizations that reduce its GPU latency.
Profile this quantized ONNX model on QNN, identify the dominant accelerator region, and test graph and QDQ-boundary changes to lower latency.
WinML QNN tracing attributes nearly all accelerator time to the positional grouped Conv in my existing Wav2Vec2 ONNX graph. Optimize its representation and boundary placement.
Resume the interrupted WinML ONNX optimization run from state.json. Check artifact and provider-option hashes before reusing earlier measurements.
In our existing ONNX optimization run, validate the supplied candidate numerically only. Structural checks already passed; do not start another search or measure latency.
Our WinML optimization leader passed candidate gates but clean replay failed. Diagnose that replay failure without publishing or substituting an old artifact.
Finish delivery of the confirmed ONNX optimization leader through the WinML report, fresh replay, versioned bundle, and promotion handoff gates.
An ONNX optimization prototype passed graph, correctness, paired latency, and trace gates. Implement the missing generic WinML optimizer capability and revalidate the exact public CLI path.
Add support for a previously unsupported Hugging Face model architecture in winml-cli, including its exporter and first recipe. This is model onboarding, not latency optimization.
Add a new execution-provider backend for a vendor NPU runtime in winml-cli; do not optimize a model graph.
Export this PyTorch model to ONNX only. Do not tune, profile, or optimize its latency.
Explain how ONNX Runtime QNN EPContext compilation is structured. This is a conceptual question; no optimization experiment is requested.
Which execution provider should I choose on a Snapdragon laptop, QNN or DirectML? Give a conceptual comparison, not a tuning workflow.
Run a one-off latency benchmark of this existing ONNX model on CPU using winml perf. Report the measurement only; do not search for optimizations.
Fine-tune a transformer model on my classification dataset to improve task accuracy; do not export to ONNX or tune runtime latency.
Optimize this SQL query and explain which database indexes would reduce latency.
Improve my chatbot system prompt to make answers more concise. No model graph or inference runtime work is needed.
Explain the p50, p90, and p99 latency labels in an existing WinML report. Do not run tools, change the report, or begin optimization.
Explain why this ONNX graph is slow on QNN, then implement and validate graph optimizations with WinML to reduce its NPU latency.
Benchmark the baseline and graph candidates as part of our WinML ONNX optimization run, then select and validate the fastest correct leader.
Describe what the WinML ONNX optimizer flags mean. This is documentation explanation only, not a request to optimize a model.
What do the QNN profiler hardware-time and DRAM counters mean? Answer conceptually; no tuning or optimization workflow is requested.
